name: WildWeave Film Studio Extension
description: WildWeave's film studio as 22 tools and an MCP server: read and edit a film's timeline and sidecar in a wilds.ai account through the studio's API with a per-account key, export it into the film repository, run the local film engine (cut, validate, strip, coverage, render, preview push) and keep the proposals yes-list.
features: Remote mode: the studio's routes on wilds.ai with a per-account studio key in the Authorization header, behind the studio's Forge gate
Local mode: the film engine's command (pnpm wildweave-film <subcommand> --json) in a wilds-ai checkout the host names, through execFile with an argument array
Edits as ops (reorder, move, trim, clip window and sound, transitions, beds, sound marks, text layers) guarded by each document's edit time, idempotent by edit id
The edit log and a revert to before any row of it
An export into the film repository written all or nothing, checked against the repository's last crossing, then acknowledged
Preview readiness per scene and the preview push of draft parts and encoded beds
The proposals yes-list: submit, list, and record a decision with his words verbatim
An MCP server over stdio (the wildweave-film-mcp bin) and over streamable HTTP on the loopback address
Every remote call under a deadline, retried by rule, with request ids; the key never logged or echoed
